summary_1line: Rishi Jaratkaru marries Vasuki’s sister under strict conditions, she conceives, wakes him at sunset for prayers, and he angrily resolves to leave her.

image_candidates.scene_text: The pregnant sister of Vasuki gently wakes the sleeping sage Jaratkaru as the red sun sets beyond the western mountains.
Jaratkaru lies with his head on his wife’s lap in a chamber of the serpent king, while twilight light enters the room.
Tearful and trembling, Vasuki’s sister folds her hands before the angry sage who prepares to abandon her.
